key_insight: A closed-loop validation-repair pipeline can turn clinical LLM outputs into highly schema-compliant structured data for healthcare interoperability.
clinical_relevance: This could help clinical AI outputs fit EHR, billing, and exchange standards such as ICD-10, CPT, and HL7 FHIR more reliably.
method: Tested Qwen2.5 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemma2 9B locally
Ran 320 clinical scenarios across 10 specialties for 960 model-scenario pairs
Compared baseline output with a validation-repair loop using schema checks
evidence_signal: Baseline compliance was 85.9%–91.6%, and validation-repair raised overall compliance to 99.0% across models, with p-values below 0.001.
watch_item: High compliance does not guarantee clinical correctness, and deployment still requires careful standard maintenance and workflow integration.
paper_title: Closed-Loop Validation-Repair for Healthcare Interoperability: A Multi-Model Study of Schema Compliance in Clinical LLMs
